propositions: Environment-read helpers absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS table silently fail to register, causing their keys to be dropped from generated docs/env-vars.md instead of raising an error.
The current generator fails CLOSED for unrecognized os.environ attributes (bug 1979) but fails OPEN for unregistered helpers, creating asymmetric hazard postures for the same underlying problem.

Two operator-advertised env vars (REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE) are undocumented because _gate_str_pref lacks a KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS row, confirmed by regression: adding the row changes docs count from 120 to 122 keys.

A helper whose os.environ key expression references its own parameters is an env-read helper by construction; such parameterized shims are enumerable (9 across 557 files) and detectable via dataflow rather than naming convention.

Tests must verify that adding an unregistered parameterized-shim helper raises UnregisteredEnvReadHelper, and that removing a row for an in-use helper fails loudly instead of shrinking the registry (b00f scenario replay).
